Mission Local reported in September 2023 that SF State was planning significant staffing cuts amid a budget deficit and enrollment below target. The story said lecturers would bear the largest reductions, with some classes cut back or eliminated for spring. It also described proposed cuts to tenure-track faculty and staff positions.

The article’s correction clarifies that SF State was 16% below its target enrollment—not that enrollment itself had dropped by 16%.
